question: What’s the closest hotel between Hebrew Senior Care, West Hartford, CT and University of New Haven New London Campus, New London, CT?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-72.729549 41.802734)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-72.092202 41.327524)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-72.729549 41.802734)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-72.729549 41.802734)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Hebrew Senior Care, West Hartford, CT
